fact: The UGD release log says Torolalana became an informational and transactional portal in v2.0.0, integrating services of public services and State bodies, with no count given.

Public Digital reports Madagascar's Digital Governance Unit built the multi-channel public services portal Torolalana, whose in-person channel Mahatoky has been piloted in 4 post offices, supports 400 processes and holds 206 citizen accounts, with transactional services still to be added to the informative ones offered.
Madagascar's anti-corruption bureau BIANCO launched the i-Fanagna platform, which lets liable persons file asset and economic-interest declarations remotely; the African Development Bank financed it.
